answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 48935 Country: India Title: My daughter name Question: My daughter’s name is SARIYAH MARYAM & her age is 4 years. This name is ok for girls. Answer ID: 48935 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1669/1335/B=12/1434) You can keep this name (Sariya Maryam) for your daughter. It is alright, this is correct name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
